content: Overselling stock happens from read-then-write races: two checkouts both read stock=1, both decrement, resulting in stock=-1. Fixes: pessimistic row locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE / EF Core transaction + reload) guarantees correctness but serializes throughput; optimistic concurrency (version/rowversion column, conditional UPDATE ... WHERE stock >= qty AND version = X) scales better and is preferred for most storefronts, retrying on conflict. The decrement must happen inside the same DB transaction as order creation, not as a separate step.
